data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 1.7m (2019: deterioration of GBP 0.3m).

named_events.loss_description: The current ultimate estimated losses for Hurricane Laura are gross and net $13.4m, this loss is protected by both surplus reinsurance and excess of loss covers. Hurricane Laura remains covered within the excess of loss programme which offers some protection for deterioration to the net ultimate loss.

The current ultimate gross and net loss is $0.8m. Due to the nature of the COVID-19 loss there may be areas where active contract exclusions exist, it is possible these may be disputed by clients or where cover is granted following legal rulings.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 gross claims outstanding were GBP 7.252m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows adverse re-estimation on prior (pre-2019) years, with a gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 0.628m (c.8.7% of opening gross claims). The report also notes a net deterioration of GBP 1.7m on prior years (net of reinsurance). The movement is attributed to adverse claims development and increases in claims estimates; named 2020 events that influenced reserves included Hurricane Laura and COVID-19 pandemic exposures.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of GBP 1.7m in respect of reserves set in prior years
overall deficit in ultimate claims of GBP 2.0m (2019: surplus of GBP 0.4m) due primarily to an increase in claims estimates
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (figures printed in GBP '000). The narrative explicitly states a net deterioration of GBP 1.7m (net of reinsurance) but does not provide a gross prior-year movement; therefore the triangle was used (confidence 0.8). Some event loss amounts are quoted in USD in the report ($13.4m and $0.8m) and have been left null in net_loss_gbp_m because no GBP conversion was provided in the financial statements. RITC and commutations are present elsewhere in the notes and can distort development patterns; the triangle column used (2018) is an individual underwriting year and was used in accordance with the instructions.
